pages.text: $(italic)Pure melee investment. Best for Berserker, Vanguard, Samurai, Paladin.$()$(br2)All nodes are attribute-based — they apply immediately, no KubeJS required.

pages.title: Nodes
pages.text: $(bold)Melee Damage$() — Core trunk — increases base melee damage via Pufferfish's Attributes melee_damage attribute.$(br2)$(bold)Sword Mastery / Axe Mastery$() — Branch 1 / Branch 2 — exclusive choice. Sword branch adds crit chance; Axe branch adds armor shred.$(br2)$(bold)Attack Speed$() — Mid-trunk node. Increases attack speed attribute. Combines with $(thing)Orc$() racial for extreme attack rate.

pages.title: Nodes (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Tamed Damage / Tamed Resistance$() — Dedicated nodes for summoner builds — increases damage dealt by and to your tamed/summoned entities.$(br2)$(bold)Warfare Capstone$() — Requires 35+ Warfare nodes: $(bold)Berserker's Will$() — On kill, +5% damage for 10s. Stacks 5x.
